summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return covering daily buybacks of its Class A ordinary shares (HKEX 09888) for cancellation. Across September 7-14, 2026, the company repurchased 3,314,650 shares on-market at prices ranging from HKD 89.2402 to HKD 92.3830 per share, each tranche roughly 0.025% of issued shares. Issued Class A shares held flat at 2,209,541,178 with no treasury shares. The buybacks are board-authorized under Main Board Rule 13.25C; cancellation timing and pace are the risk-arb watch items.
